## Use this capability when the user means

- learn physics interactively
- study mechanics gravity or thermodynamics
- learn electromagnetism waves or optics
- explore relativity quantum nuclear or particle physics
- test a physics prediction before seeing the answer
- connect physical models to evidence

## Authority

public read-only physics learning and interactive prediction exercises

## Boundaries

- simplified teaching models must be labeled as models rather than direct measurements
- equations and scientific uncertainty should remain visible where material
- educational simulations are not engineering certification or safety analysis
- private learner or account data is outside public discovery
